theater: 旁遮普邦蘇特利治河中游

battle.name: 第一次英國錫克戰爭
battle.theater: 旁遮普邦蘇特利治河中游
battle.brief: 一八四五年十二月，錫克軍越過蘇特利治河入侵英屬旁遮普，四個月內連輸穆德基、費羅澤沙赫、阿利瓦爾與索布拉翁四戰。卡面嘅法製雷管步槍正係英軍步兵同代槍種：底火不受風雨影響，射程可及三四百碼，錫克密集騎兵在衝鋒途中即被齊射打散，戰局自此一面倒。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 一八四五年冬天，交戰的兩方隔著蘇特利治河相望：西岸是東印度公司治下的旁遮普與孟加拉轄區，東岸是錫克帝國本土。英方以孟加拉軍為主體，摻入孟買與馬德拉斯兩總督轄下的步兵、炮兵與工兵，野戰總指揮是印度總司令休·高夫中將，印度總督亨利·哈丁奇則掌握最高軍政大權；靠「附屬同盟」體系，數十萬平方英里的印度邦國早已由公司軍隊代為「保護」，但花在旁遮普身上的錢，遠比剛被公司平定的廓爾喀、馬哈拉施特拉與阿瓦爾多。英軍步兵以印度土兵為主，連營多由英籍軍官率領，另有西穆爾的廓爾喀山地營、新募的旁遮普步兵團，以及駐紮北印度的炮兵、工兵與先鋒隊。錫克方是蘭吉特·辛格一八三九年去世後由年幼的杜利普·辛格繼位的卡爾薩軍隊，國政由攝政辛格哈拉辛、議政的「古魯」會與總理迪萬拉爾辛格共管；野戰大軍名義上歸國王，實際分由米斯爾·迪萬·昌德拉姆、薩爾達爾·阿塔爾·辛格、阿卡利·普勒·辛格等分區統率，喀什米爾方向另由謝赫·伊馬姆丁率軍與重砲隊。錫克軍以成建制的重騎兵團與外人眼中極為精銳的火砲營為骨幹，營帳與糧秣靠大隊牛車群負載；英軍則沿蘇特利治河維持一條單薄的補給線，砲兵與步兵都靠船運與擔夫向前推進。
countriesEn: The two sides faced each other across the Sutlej in the winter of 1845: on the western bank lay the Punjab and the Bengal territories under the East India Company, on the eastern bank the homeland of the Sikh Empire. The British force was built around the Bengal Army, with infantry, artillery and sappers drawn in from the Bombay and Madras presidencies; overall command belonged to the Commander-in-Chief in India, Lieutenant-General Sir Hugh Gough, while the Governor-General, Sir Henry Hardinge, held the highest civil and military authority. Through the system of subsidiary alliances, dozens of Indian states were already 'protected' by Company troops, but the money spent on Punjab was far greater than what had been required to reduce the Gurkhas, the Mahrattas and Awadh. British line regiments were composed mainly of Indian sepoys under British officers, alongside the Sirmoor Gurkha battalions of the Himalayan foothills, newly raised Punjab regiments, and the artillery, engineer and pioneer units stationed in northern India. On the Sikh side stood the Khalsa army of the empire, ruled after Ranjit Singh's death by the child Maharaja Duleep Singh, with state policy in the hands of the regent Kharak Singh, the council of Gurus and the Diwan (prime minister) Lal Singh. The field army was nominally the king's, but in practice was divided among separate commanders such as Misr Diwan Chand, Sardar Attar Singh and Akali Phule Singh, while the Kashmir wing and its heavy guns were led by Shaikh Imam-ud-din. The Sikh army rested on massed cavalry regiments and on an artillery arm that British observers considered among the best in the world; tents and grain moved with it in vast bullock trains. The British, by contrast, kept a single thin supply line along the Sutlej, feeding guns and infantry forward by boat and by porters.
people: 留下姓名的，多半是英軍一邊。休·高夫是核心：半島戰爭與對華戰爭出身的老兵，四十出頭已率領公司最重的一支部隊，他在穆德基與費羅澤沙赫採用自己改良的「斜列陣」——正面只留一營接敵，其餘各營以斜角依次向右後旋進，用捲入的火力把錫克密集隊形一層層削開。總督哈丁奇是把政治目標變成軍事命令的人：他不接受錫克遊騎隊在西北邊境反覆越界，認定只要旁遮普仍由蘭吉特家族的幼主坐鎮，公司在喜馬拉雅山麓就沒有真正的邊界。哈里·史密斯中將在阿利瓦爾獨當一面，靠一紙急行軍令讓孟加拉第一步兵（潘迪步兵）及時趕到戰場取勝，戰後獲封騎士；英方在拉合爾的政治代表是亨利·勞倫斯，日後他成了旁遮普駐紮總督的雛形。錫克一方，幼王杜利普·辛格只有八歲，實權握在總理拉爾辛格與攝政辛格哈拉辛手上；前線最高指揮是經驗最豐富的米斯爾·迪萬·昌德拉姆，但他正忙於攻取喀什米爾，無暇回師；並肩作戰的還有阿卡利·普勒·辛格與薩爾達爾·阿塔爾·辛格，阿利瓦爾一役錫克炮隊的指揮則是賈馬達爾·赫姆辛格。真正做出關鍵決定的還有那些小人物：把火砲從泥濘裡拖出來的牛車伕、雪夜裡按響雷管步槍的英軍步兵團士長，以及費羅澤沙赫夜戰中率六十騎衝進錫克砲群的霍德森騎兵隊長。
peopleEn: Fewer names survive on the two sides than one might expect, but the decisive ones are well documented. For the British the central figure was Hugh Gough, a soldier of the Peninsular War and of the China campaign who by his early forties commanded the Company's heaviest field force. At Mudki and Ferozeshah he used his own improved 'oblique order': only one company engaged in front while the rest of the line came on at an angle, swinging in from the right rear, so that the fire of the whole line rolled forward and peeled the Sikh formations apart layer by layer. The Governor-General, Hardinge, was the man who turned political aims into military orders. He refused to accept unchallenged Sikh raids across the north-west frontier, and held that until Punjab was under a child king the Company would never have a settled border at the foot of the Himalaya. Harry Smith commanded a division of his own at Aliwal and won the day by a single order of forced march that brought the 1st Bengal Native Infantry, 'Pandy's infantry', into position in time; he was knighted afterwards. Henry Lawrence, then the Company's political agent at Lahore, would later become the prototype of the Punjab Chief Commissioner. On the Sikh side the child Maharaja Duleep Singh was only eight years old, and real power lay with the Diwan Lal Singh and the regent Kharak Singh and his kin. The senior field commander was Misr Diwan Chand, who was occupied with reducing Kashmir and could not come south; with him were Akali Phule Singh and Sardar Attar Singh, and the Sikh guns at Aliwal were commanded by Jamadar Khem Singh. And there are the smaller decisions: the bullock drivers who dragged the guns out of the mud, the British sergeant who snapped a percussion cap in a snowstorm, and the officer of Hodson's Horse who led sixty riders into the Sikh battery in the dark.
kits: 戰場上真正的技術分水嶺是火器。英軍步兵使用雷管步槍這一世代的槍：法製一八四〇年式與一八四二年式雷管步槍是當時歐洲陸軍的標準制式，其後的英軍步槍——恩菲爾德三八式改雷管者、布拉格一·五七英寸步槍——同屬一個技術世代；雷管底火不怕潮濕、風沙與夜霧，不再需要火盤與火繩架，士兵臥倒、奔跑、躍過溝渠之後可以立刻還擊，有效射程從百來碼推到兩三百碼以外，密集的錫克騎兵在衝鋒途中就成片倒地。錫克步兵的主力仍是火繩槍與燧發的「圖帕克」長槍，擊發慢、射程短，必須靠近到百餘碼才能有效射擊，這正是英軍反覆把射擊距離定在二百至四百碼的原因。錫克真正的技術強項在火砲：喀什米爾工匠鑄出的青銅重砲射速極快，炮手訓練極嚴，裝藥與瞄準都按歐洲標準做，旁遮普自己設計的銅砲與後膛裝填的野砲都曾被英軍繳獲當作樣品；再加上西北邊境運來的火箭，覆蓋的縱深更遠。冷兵器方面，錫克步兵仍大量裝備查克拉姆圓環鐵刃與四刺鐵盤，配長劍「薩爾帕奇」與三叉長矛「巴查」；英軍這邊是刺刀加步槍，廓爾喀山地兵則帶著庫克利彎刀。
kitsEn: The real technical divide of this war lay in small arms. British infantry carried rifles of the percussion generation: the French model 1840 and model 1842 percussion muskets were standard issue in European armies of the day, and the British service weapons that followed - the Enfield 1837 converted to percussion, the 0.577-inch Brunswick - belonged to the same technical family. A percussion cap needed no priming pan, no flint and no frizzen, so it fired in rain, fog and darkness; a rifleman could drop to the ground, move and shoot again at once. Effective range went out from a hundred-odd yards to three hundred and beyond, and massed Sikh cavalry began falling in the open before they could close. The Sikh infantry, by contrast, was still largely armed with matchlocks and flintecks, the long 'tupak' musket among them, slow to fire and short in range, and had to close to within a hundred yards or so to shoot effectively, which is why the British kept choosing firing distances of two to four hundred yards. The Sikh strength lay in their artillery: bronze heavy guns cast in the Kashmir workshops, fired fast, worked by crews trained to a discipline British officers openly praised, with powder and sighting laid up to European standards, while the Punjab-designed pieces and rear-loading field guns captured by the British were carried away as specimens. Rockets from the north-west frontier added further reach. In the close fight the Sikhs still carried chakram rings and four-bladed steel discs, the long 'sarpachi' sword and the three-pronged 'barcha' spear; on the British side, bayonet and rifle, with the Gurkhas of the hills carrying their kukri.
tactics: 英軍在四場戰役中反覆使用同一套戰術，核心是高夫改進的「斜列陣」：正面只留一營接敵，其餘各營以斜角依次向右後旋進，前面一營被壓住時，後面的營就從側面把火力疊上去，形成一層層捲入敵陣的火力幕。步兵以線形橫列前進，射手分散兵線與主力線兩層，散兵先在前方擾亂敵軍前排，後方主力營再以整齊齊射打亂對方陣腳；對付錫克騎兵一律收攏成空心方陣四面拒止，野砲配在方陣四隅與陣後。進攻前先由炮兵「轟擊」，以六磅、九磅野砲和二十四磅榴砲在三四百碼外打散錫克縱隊，砲火一停，步兵即發起衝鋒，砲兵隨後跟進。錫克軍的戰術則是另一套：重騎兵以數千人規模的密集方陣反覆衝鋒，衝鋒前先用火砲與火箭犁鬆英軍陣線，再以查克拉姆與長矛近身；他們樂於夜戰，費羅澤沙赫就是在雪夜裡紮成新月形營壘被英軍攻入；營壘之間以牛車與帳幕連成一片，撤退時可以互相掩護，缺點卻是營帳拖累，一旦被突破便連營帶車一併淪陷。補給上，英軍沿河推進、靠船隊運糧，錫克軍須自備數週口糧，遠征與冬營的消耗是它後半程崩潰的主因。
tacticsEn: Across all four battles the British repeated one system of tactics, the core of which was Gough's improved 'oblique order': only one company engaged in front while the rest of the line came on at an angle, swinging in from the right rear, so that when the leading company was pressed the companies behind delivered their fire from the flank and the line rolled forward like a curtain. The infantry advanced in line, with skirmishers thrown out in front to disorder the enemy's leading ranks and the formed companies behind delivering deliberate volleys; against Sikh cavalry the line closed into hollow squares, refusing on all four sides, with field guns at the angles of the square and behind it. Before an attack the batteries 'bombarded', six-, nine- and twenty-four-pound guns breaking the Sikh columns at two to four hundred yards, and the instant the gun fire stopped the infantry charged, the batteries following in. The Sikhs fought on an entirely different system: heavy cavalry in masses of thousands charged again and again, artillery and rockets softening the British line before the charge, then the chakram and the long spears at close quarters. They liked to fight at night, and Ferozeshah was a crescent encampment assaulted in a snowstorm. The camps were strung together with bullock carts and tents so that a retreat could be covered, but the same baggage crippled them once a breach was made. Logistically the British pushed along the river and fed themselves by boat, while the Sikh army had to carry its own rations for weeks on end, and the strain of campaigning and winter bivouacs was a main reason for its collapse in the closing weeks.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。錫克軍主力約二萬五千至三萬人，火砲約五十門，於一八四五年十二月十三日起從洛迪海爾、羅帕爾等處分批渡過蘇特利治河，營地前推到穆德基與費羅澤沙赫一線。穆德基一戰（十二月十八日），英軍出動約一萬一千人、二十二門野砲，錫克軍損失約二千人陣亡、三千至四千人被俘，十八至二十門火砲被繳獲；英軍亦有約二百人陣亡、近六百人受傷。費羅澤沙赫（十二月二十一日至二十二日）英軍投入約一萬八千人、八十八門砲，錫克軍約二萬五千人，同樣有八十八門砲；英軍傷亡最重，約七百人陣亡、一千六百餘人受傷，錫克方面約二千五百人陣亡、三千五百人左右被俘。阿利瓦爾（一八四六年一月二十八日）規模較小，英軍約六千人、十八門砲，錫克軍約一萬二千人、三門砲；錫克方面傷亡約三千人，其中被俘約二千人，英軍損失約二百人陣亡、七百人受傷。索布拉翁（二月二十一日）英軍約二萬四千人、八十七門砲，錫克軍約四萬人、六十七門砲，錫克方面被擊斃約五千人、被俘約五千人，英軍損失約八百人。和約條件同樣有數：錫克軍裁減至一萬二千步兵與三千騎兵，賠償一百五十萬英鎊，火砲、馬匹與「科伊諾爾」鑽石一併交付。各場兵力與砲數以常見統計為準，不同文獻略有出入。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Sikh field army numbered some twenty-five to thirty thousand men with about fifty guns, and from 13 December 1845 it began crossing the Sutlej in several columns, at Lodhikal, Ropar and further up, pushing its camps to the Mudki and Ferozeshah line. At Mudki on 18 December the British fielded about eleven thousand men and twenty-two field guns; the Sikhs lost roughly two thousand killed and three to four thousand taken prisoner, and eighteen to twenty of their guns were captured, while the British lost about two hundred killed and nearly six hundred wounded. At Ferozeshah, on 21-22 December, the British committed about eighteen thousand men and eighty-eight guns against a Sikh army of about twenty-five thousand with the same number of guns; here the British suffered most, some seven hundred killed and more than sixteen hundred wounded, while the Sikhs lost around two thousand five hundred killed and about three thousand five hundred captured. Aliwal on 28 January 1846 was the smaller engagement: about six thousand British with eighteen guns against roughly twelve thousand Sikhs and three guns; the Sikh losses were about three thousand men, some two thousand of them captured, against British losses of about two hundred killed and seven hundred wounded. At Sobraon on 21 February the British had about twenty-four thousand men and eighty-seven guns against some forty thousand Sikhs and sixty-seven guns; the Sikh field army was destroyed to the tune of about five thousand men with as many more prisoners, the British losing roughly eight hundred. The settlement was equally precise: the Sikh army was cut to twelve thousand infantry and three thousand cavalry, a war indemnity of one and a half million pounds sterling was imposed, and the guns, the horses and the Koh-i-Noor diamond were handed over. Figures for guns and for strength, particularly at Ferozeshah, vary slightly between authorities.
cause: 一八四五年開戰不是偶然。蘭吉特·辛格一八三九年去世後，旁遮普出現權力真空：幼王杜利普·辛格繼位，攝政與總理輪流掌權，蘭吉特的將領們各擁兵自重。為養活龐大的常備軍，也為了轉移內部注意力，卡爾薩軍隊在西北方向不斷擴張：一八四四年起越過阿托克進攻克什米爾方向的小邦，同時藉口「追討叛逃者」一再越過蘇特利治河，進入公司管轄的卡蘇爾與賈蘭杜阿布，把英方視為最後通牒的邊境襲擊一路推到加爾各答的總督桌上。公司當時已完成對廓爾喀、馬哈拉施特拉與阿瓦爾的戰爭，無力再打一場大仗，但殖民當局認定錫克一旦西進，旁遮普與喜馬拉雅山麓的邊界就永遠無法確定，於是把「保衛西北邊疆」當成不可迴避的任務。一八四五年八月起英軍在蘇特利治河東岸集結，十二月十二日高夫致信錫克總理要求退軍，最後通牒被拒，錫克軍遂在十三日夜渡河，衝突由邊境事件升級為全面戰爭。
causeEn: The war of 1845 did not come out of the blue. Ranjit Singh died in 1839 and left a political vacuum in Punjab: the child Duleep Singh succeeded him, the regency and the Diwan took turns holding real power, and Ranjit's generals each commanded troops of their own. To feed a huge standing army and to distract it, the Khalsa armies pushed continually to the north-west. From 1844 they crossed the Attock into the smaller states on the Kashmir side, and at the same time, under the pretext of chasing deserters, they rode across the Sutlej into Company territory at Kasur and in the Jalandur Doab, until border raids the Company treated as an ultimatum reached the Governor-General's desk in Calcutta. By then the Company had fought through the Gurkhas, the Mahrattas and Awadh and had no appetite for another large war, but British colonial officialdom held that the moment the Sikhs pushed west there would never be a fixed frontier on the Punjab side, and took the defence of the north-west border as a task that could not be deferred. From August 1845 the British concentrated on the east bank of the Sutlej; on 12 December Gough wrote to the Diwan requiring the Sikh army to withdraw, the ultimatum was refused, and on the night of the thirteenth the Khalsa crossed the Sutlej, turning a border incident into a general war.
impact: 對英國而言，這是一場以低成本換來高收益的戰爭：公司軍隊沒有被拖進歐洲大陸那種泥潭，就在四個冬天裡打垮了南亞最強的軍隊，於是握住了旁遮普的稅收、恆河平原的糧食，以及蘇特利治河這條天然邊界線，公司的西北邊界從喜馬拉雅山麓推到阿托克一線；次年公司支持錫克軍攻取喀什米爾，把英屬印度的北界推到喜馬拉雅山本身，此後英國與俄羅斯在西北的角力便以克什米爾與阿托克線為核心展開。對錫克帝國而言，這是致命的斷裂：蘭吉特·辛格建立起來的、由火砲與騎兵支撐的卡爾薩職業軍雖然裝備與技術不遜歐洲，但指揮系統鬆散，沒有統一的全役計畫；首都拉合爾幾乎未設防，國庫與土地稅基被和約掏空，軍隊被限制在一萬五千人以內，主權只靠外交維持。幼王杜利普·辛格此後在檻中度過半生，一八四八年英錫戰爭再起時，錫克方面更無力抵抗。另一個長遠影響在軍隊的忠誠：經一八四五年戰事招募的錫克步兵團，往後成為公司最可靠的部隊之一，一八五七年印度起義時並未倒戈，反而協助鎮壓。
impactEn: For Britain this was a war that cost little and paid enormously. Company troops were not drawn into a continental bog of the kind that ruined Napoleon; within four winter months they broke the strongest army in South Asia and took hold of the revenues of Punjab, the grain of the Gangetic plain and the Sutlej as a natural frontier line, pushing the Company's north-west border up to the Attock. The following year the Company backed the Sikh conquest of Kashmir, carrying the northern frontier of British India onto the Himalaya itself, and from then on the Anglo-Russian contest in the north-west turned on Kashmir and the Attock line. For the Sikh Empire the war was a fatal fracture. The Khalsa professional army built by Ranjit Singh was well armed and technically equal to European troops, but its command system was loose and it had no concept of a combined campaign. The capital at Lahore was almost undefended, the treasury and the land revenue base were gutted by the settlement, and the army was confined to fifteen thousand men, so that sovereignty survived only as diplomacy. The boy Maharaja Duleep Singh spent the rest of his life in captivity, and when the Second Anglo-Sikh War broke out in 1848 the Sikhs were even less able to resist. A more durable legacy lay in the loyalty of the troops: the Sikh infantry regiments raised in the course of 1845 became some of the Company's most reliable units, and when the Indian rising came in 1857 they did not defect but helped put it down.
result: 四場戰役的結果是把錫克軍隊的進攻能力徹底打掉：穆德基摧毀了錫克砲隊並奪走十八門以上火砲，費羅澤沙赫雪夜攻破新月形營壘，阿利瓦爾消滅了最精銳的一支炮隊與護衛它的重騎兵，索布拉翁則在蘇特利治河畔包圍並解決了整支野戰軍的有生力量；英軍隨後圍困拉合爾，於一八四六年三月九日破城，迫使錫克方面在一八四六年三月二十九日簽訂《拉合爾條約》。條約的核心不是割地，而是把旁遮普變成公司的附屬：杜利普·辛格保留王位與虛名主權，公司的常駐代表坐鎮拉合爾，錫克軍裁減至一萬二千步兵與三千騎兵並不得再越過蘇特利治河，公司取得一百五十萬英鎊賠償，錫克的重砲、馬匹與財產一併清點交付，連同刻有「光榮或死亡」銘文的那門名砲也被交還。第一場英錫戰爭至此結束，公司的影響從此正式伸進旁遮普的每一寸土地，也把第二場英錫戰爭變成只剩時間問題。
resultEn: The four battles stripped the Sikh army of any power to attack. Mudki destroyed the Sikh artillery and took away eighteen or more guns; Ferozeshah breached the crescent camp in a snowstorm; Aliwal annihilated the finest of the Sikh batteries together with the heavy cavalry that protected them; Sobraon surrounded and finished the entire field army by the banks of the Sutlej. The British then invested Lahore, breached the walls on 9 March 1846, and forced the Sikh government to sign the Treaty of Lahore on 29 March 1846. The heart of the treaty was not the loss of territory but the reduction of Punjab to a subsidiary state: Duleep Singh kept the throne and a nominal sovereignty, a Company resident sat at Lahore, the Sikh army was cut to twelve thousand infantry and three thousand cavalry and was forbidden to cross the Sutlej, the Company took one and a half million pounds sterling in indemnity, the Sikh heavy guns, horses and property were inventoried and handed over, and even the famous gun with the inscription 'Death or Glory' was returned. The First Anglo-Sikh War was over, the Company's influence now reached into every acre of Punjab, and the Second Anglo-Sikh War became a question of time alone.
